# Mythic Territories

> A premium turn-based strategy game where you command elemental factions — Snow or Ash — in tactical head-to-head combat. Free to play in your browser.

## About the Game

Mythic Territories is a browser-based, turn-based strategy game built with modern web technologies (React, Vite). Two players — or one player vs an AI — battle across a tactical board using unique faction units, each with special abilities. The game features an Ascension mechanic, Destiny Wheel spins, and a detailed faction guide (Rulebook).

## Key Pages

- [Home / Lobby](https://mythic-territories.xyz/) — Start a local match, create an online room, or spin the Destiny Wheel
- [Rulebook / Guide](https://mythic-territories.xyz/?page=rules) — Full game rules, unit stats, faction abilities, and strategy tips
- [Patch Notes](https://mythic-territories.xyz/?page=notes) — Changelog and balance updates
- [Destiny Wheel](https://mythic-territories.xyz/?page=wheel) — Spin for a random unit unlock or bonus

## Factions

**Ash Faction** — Fire and volcanic units. Aggressive, high-damage playstyle.
Units include: Ash Reaper, Ash Tyrant, Blaze Runner, Cinder Scout, Hell Hound, Magma Prowler, Magma Shaper, Magma Spitter, Rift Forger, Scorch Priest, Obsidian Shaper.

**Ice / Snow Faction** — Frost and arctic units. Defensive, control-based playstyle.
Units include: Arctic Trapper, Cryomancer, Frost Lord, Glacial Brute, Hoarfrost Mystic, Ice Weaver, Snow Wolf, Soul Freeze, Soul Linker, Void Chanter, Wisp, Yeti.

## Game Mechanics

- Turn-based grid combat
- Each faction has a unique Leader with special abilities
- Ascension system: units can ascend to stronger forms
- Destiny Wheel: randomised bonuses and unit unlocks
- Online multiplayer (room codes) and local 2-player mode
- AI opponent available for single-player

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP animations
- Multiplayer: Socket.IO (real-time)
- Assets: WebP images, SVG badges, Web Workers for AI
